en.headline: Hong Kong Pride Rainbow Market at Central Market cancelled
en.dek: Organisers said the venue cited an administrative error after confirming the booking and receiving a deposit; this is the second year a planned venue fell through after details were announced.
body: The organising committee of Hong Kong Pride Parade 2026 announced that the Rainbow Market scheduled for 14 November at Central Market has been cancelled because the venue said it could no longer provide the space.

The committee said it contacted Central Market in early June, received confirmation the same month, and paid a deposit in July. In late August it publicly announced the date and venue. More than a month later the venue notified the committee that staff had made an administrative error by double-booking the date, and that no alternative Chinachem Group venue was available in November.

Organisers noted this is the second consecutive year a planned venue became unavailable after details were announced and payment made. Last year a planned inclusive culture festival at Kwun Tong waterfront was also cancelled at short notice. The committee said it would continue efforts to stage the event and would announce new arrangements later.
The market was to have been free admission, running from noon to 7pm on the ground-floor Oasis and first-floor event space, under the theme of stepping forward to pave the way for coming out.

zh.headline: 香港同志遊行彩虹市集因中環街市場地取消
zh.dek: 籌委會指場地確認及收取訂金後以「行政出錯」重複租場為由未能提供場地，已是連續第二年公布詳情後場地出問題。
body: 香港同志遊行2026活動籌委會公布，原定11月14日在中環街市舉行的彩虹市集因場地方表示未能再提供場地而取消。
籌委會表示6月初與中環街市接洽並獲確認可租用，7月已繳付訂金。8月底在社交媒體公布日期及場地後，一個多月後接獲通知指職員行政出錯，把同一日場地重複租予兩個活動，而華應集團旗下亦無其他11月可用場地。
籌委會指這已是連續第二年在公布活動詳情及繳費後場地突然出現問題。去年計劃在觀塘海濱舉行的共融文化節同樣在短時間內被取消租場。籌委會表示會盡最大努力繼續籌辦，並適時公布最新安排。
市集原定免費入場，中午12時至晚上7時在地下中庭Oasis及一樓活動場地舉行，主題為「我們行多步，為現身舖路」。
